families.linear_v6: 18 parameters; saved v6 outer-fold predictions reused unchanged
families.global_steps: 21 parameters; four shared nonnegative tare increments
families.context_steps: 117 parameters; four nonnegative tare increments per shade/vintage context; partial pooling toward global step curve

method.constraints: Lighter tare cannot reduce score. Linear inequalities preserve younger/lighter-shade weak monotonicity at every supported tare. Provenance remains additive, so no provenance-specific tare curve is included.
method.objective: Same direct-ranking squared hinge + squared exact-tie gap penalties, with comparable ridge on global mean and extra pooling on context deviations
method.selection: Same five seeds and outer 5 / inner 3 family folds, alpha/pooling/threshold grids; tune on training only. Equal-price cases receive no extra weight.
method.limits: Exploratory architecture selected after error audit; nonrandom adaptive evidence, no pristine holdout. 117 parameters require strong shrinkage. Classification tie is not necessarily exact score equality. Split ranges are not confidence intervals.
